name: E07 Variance Explanations
rows: Site 22's final milestone billing moved to November 6 when the customer's lender extended its draw approval. The customer's deposit was received October 31.
Follows Site 22's final milestone billing moving to November.
Compact track loader rented for the Larkfield storm repairs after the October 18 storm (AER-7731). Not in the budget.
Replacement laptops and a large-format plotter for the Larkfield site office (NOS-5521). One-time; approved by the Controller September 29.
September's duplicate amortization is reversed in October (close entry AJ-01). Below the threshold; noted for the reader.
Commission follows Site 22's final milestone billing moving to November.
